hypothesisMatrix.name: SOURCE_POSTGRES_ATTRIBUTE_REPLAY_DEMOTES_BOOTSTRAP_EXECUTOR
hypothesisMatrix.reason: Upstream PG17 rejects removal of bootstrap SUPERUSER before updating the tuple. Historical accepted postgres is non-superuser, which supports H6 instead. Other self changes can affect later sessions, but no such executed statement/order is retained.
hypothesisMatrix.supportMeaning: Source preserves self-directed ALTER statements; this does not establish successful privilege loss.

hypothesisMatrix.name: PROVIDER_MANAGED_ROLE_STATEMENT_NOT_REPLAYABLE_IN_PLAIN_OWNED_PG17
hypothesisMatrix.reason: All remaining role settings and memberships are replayed into plain owned PG17. No specific provider statement, missing extension setting or membership failure is identified. Generic compatibility possibility only.

hypothesisMatrix.name: OWNED_BOOTSTRAP_ROLE_IDENTITY_NOT_EXPLICITLY_PINNED
hypothesisMatrix.reason: UID 100:101 plus initdb without -U depends on image name mapping. E2 records readiness/inspection but no current_user/session_user/rolsuper/rolcreaterole query. Gap is established; causal role in E3 is not.

hypothesisMatrix.name: OS_OR_DOCKER_EXEC_PERMISSION_FAILURE
hypothesisMatrix.reason: Return code 3 matches psql script-stop semantics, and E1/E2/E9 succeeded, favoring a script error over general daemon denial. The receipt is the docker subprocess exit, not an independently attested psql SQLSTATE. Substring classification cannot exclude filesystem/socket/metacommand failures or every exec boundary.

hypothesisMatrix.name: ROLES_INPUT_DECODING_FORMATTING_OR_PSQL_BOUNDARY
hypothesisMatrix.reason: Actual E3 docker END proves decode and password scan completed; a prior UnicodeDecodeError or ROLE_PASSWORD rejection was not this primary failure. UTF-8 decode/re-encode succeeded. Exact global textual replacement is not parsing; quoting, line endings, psql metacommands or settings could still affect execution. No evidence of a version mismatch; historical pinned tools report 17.6, runtime identity requires major17. No new patch-version measurement.

hypothesisMatrix.name: BOOTSTRAP_NOSUPERUSER_REPLAY_REJECTED_BEFORE_DEMOTION
hypothesisMatrix.reason: Accepted persisted capture records postgres.rolsuper=false and matches the catalog hash required before Attempt2 dumps. Replay preserves attributes. Upstream PG17.6 rejects NOSUPERUSER on the bootstrap role with an error text matching the safe classifier. Missing exact roles bytes, bootstrap identity/OID proof, statement ordering and exact error prevent identification of the first failing statement.

optionComparison.name: NO_SOURCE_CHANGE_RETRY_SAME_CODE
optionComparison.reason: No evidence of an external transient or a proven environment-only remedy. A second identical execution does not repair the known assumptions and is not authorized.

optionComparison.name: POSTPONE_POSTGRES_SELF_MUTATION
optionComparison.reason: A complete SQL/psql-aware classification would have to preserve configs, membership grantors and ordering. Moving a forbidden bootstrap NOSUPERUSER operation later cannot make it legal. Final LOGIN/expiry/permissions must still permit observation and counts. Skipping the final statement or comparing before it would produce false fidelity. No selected parser or safe exact rearrangement is closed.

advantages: Restore execution can be separated from source postgres attributes.

Using the dedicated identity throughout requires reviewing OwnedTransport identity/session checks, pg_restore and both observation passes.
Renaming/mapping bootstrap to a source privileged identity requires evidence that the corresponding source role exists and compatible attributes; no mapping is inferred.
optionComparison.reason: Promising isolation architecture, but full fidelity and smallest exact source scope are not yet proven.

optionComparison.name: FILTER_PROVIDER_ROLES_OR_ATTRIBUTES
optionComparison.reason: No approved equivalence normalization exists. Omitting attributes, configs or memberships conflicts with the current exact comparison.

designRequirements: Publish exact source bytes only after source and TOC gates; private 0700 directory/0600 regular nlink1 current-UID O_EXCL leaves, no symlink, file/parent fsync and raw readback.
Bind each input to its source proof output hash; never reconstruct hashes into bytes.
No manifest VALID until E3-E8 and cleanup PASS. Preserve partial inputs and INVALID failure as append-only evidence.

Role settings can contain sensitive environment values despite --no-role-passwords; raw files stay private, no public dump/SQL/error output. Modes constrain access but do not provide encryption or a complete retention policy.
Define a versioned partial-input receipt and its inventory relationship to exact-single-backup/2 before implementation; no unaccounted extra portable files or retroactive completion.
Input persistence alone does not identify failing statement; any future safe SQLSTATE/ordinal mapping requires a separate bounded design, without raw stderr.
optionComparison.name: PERSIST_SOURCE_INPUTS_BEFORE_OWNED_RESTORE
optionComparison.reason: Useful forensic hardening, but private failed-input publication/retention and failure contract require explicit design and package successor. It does not fix E3.

optionComparison.name: RELAX_CATALOG_COMPARISON
optionComparison.reason: No semantic-equivalence proof. Keep all roles, privileges, configs, memberships including grantor/options, catalog families and counts.

optionComparison.reason: Explicit initdb identity and an owned-only privilege check would make assumptions testable, but cannot fix incompatible source bootstrap attributes by themselves. No direct catalog mutation or hidden bootstrap exception is acceptable.
